item.title: Pelēkie zirņi ar “speķi”
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Grey peas with smoky onions, mushrooms and tofu

Latvia’s national dish — veganized. Smoky “speķis” from mushrooms and tofu over tender grey peas.

Access tier: Visitor freeline. Part of Vegan Latvian Kitchen (14 recipes · 2 visitor · 2 guest · all for members + PDF).

Ingredients

  • 500 g dried Latvian grey peas
  • 2 large onions, diced
  • 250 g mushrooms, preferably brown
  • 150 g smoked tofu
  • 2 tbsp rapeseed or sunflower oil
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • 1–2 tsp liquid smoke
  • Black pepper, salt

Method

  1. Soak the grey peas overnight.
  2. Boil in fresh salted water until tender, about 45–60 minutes.
  3. Dice mushrooms and smoked tofu small.
  4. Fry onions slowly in oil until golden.
  5. Add mushrooms; cook until browned.
  6. Add tofu, smoked paprika and liquid smoke.
  7. Season with black pepper; fry until dark and slightly crisp.
  8. Spoon the smoky mixture over hot peas.

Key: the topping should be salty, rich and strongly smoky — the contrast speķis used to give.

Fully plant-based adaptation for FLOSC client UAT. Adjust salt, smoke, and timing to taste.
item.excerpt:encoded: Latvia’s national dish — veganized. Smoky “speķis” from mushrooms and tofu over tender grey peas.

item.title: Kartupeļu pankūkas
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Latvian potato pancakes

Crispy grated potato pancakes — everyday comfort, member library.

Access tier: Member / full cookbook. Part of Vegan Latvian Kitchen (14 recipes · 2 visitor · 2 guest · all for members + PDF).

Open to everyone — visitor freeline recipe 2 of 2.

Ingredients

  • 1 kg potatoes
  • 1 small onion
  • 3 tbsp flour
  • 1 tbsp potato starch
  • 1 tsp salt, black pepper
  • Oil for frying

Method

  1. Finely grate potatoes and onion; squeeze only some liquid so mixture stays moist.
  2. Stir in flour, potato starch, salt and pepper.
  3. Fry thin pancakes in hot oil until deeply golden and crispy.
  4. Serve with vegan sour cream, mushroom sauce or applesauce.

Fully plant-based adaptation for FLOSC client UAT. Adjust salt, smoke, and timing to taste.
item.excerpt:encoded: Crispy grated potato pancakes — everyday comfort, member library.

item.title: Ķimeņu siers (Jāņu siers)
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Plant-based caraway cheese for Midsummer

Jāņi on a plate — caraway “cheese” without dairy. Login freeline sample.

Access tier: Guest freeline (login). Part of Vegan Latvian Kitchen (14 recipes · 2 visitor · 2 guest · all for members + PDF).

Ingredients

  • 500 g firm tofu
  • 250 g unsweetened soy yogurt
  • 3 tbsp tapioca starch
  • 2 tbsp potato starch
  • 3 tbsp nutritional yeast
  • 3 tbsp vegan butter
  • 2 tbsp lemon juice
  • 2–3 tsp caraway seeds
  • 1½ tsp salt
  • ¼ tsp turmeric

Method

  1. Blend everything except caraway until completely smooth.
  2. Stir in caraway seeds.
  3. Cook in a heavy saucepan, stirring constantly, until very thick and stretchy.
  4. Transfer into a cheesecloth-lined bowl; fold cloth; weight lightly.
  5. Refrigerate overnight; unmold and slice.

Fully plant-based adaptation for FLOSC client UAT. Adjust salt, smoke, and timing to taste.

item.title: Aukstā zupa
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Latvian cold beet soup

Pink summer classic — plant kefir, beets, cucumber, dill. Second guest freeline recipe.

Access tier: Guest freeline (login). Part of Vegan Latvian Kitchen (14 recipes · 2 visitor · 2 guest · all for members + PDF).

Ingredients

  • 500 g cooked or pickled beetroot, grated
  • 750 ml unsweetened plant kefir, or 500 g plain soy yogurt plus 250 ml cold water
  • 1 large cucumber, diced
  • 5 spring onions
  • A large handful of fresh dill
  • 1 tbsp mustard
  • 1–2 tbsp beet pickle liquid or vinegar
  • Salt and black pepper
  • ½ tsp sugar, optional
  • Firm tofu and kala namak, optional egg stand-in

Method

  1. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.
  2. Season to taste.
  3. Refrigerate at least one hour.
  4. Serve very cold with boiled new potatoes.

Fully plant-based adaptation for FLOSC client UAT. Adjust salt, smoke, and timing to taste.
item.excerpt:encoded: Pink summer classic — plant kefir, beets, cucumber, dill. Second guest freeline recipe.

item.title: Rasols
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Latvian potato salad (vegan)

Party salad — potatoes, pickles, peas, smoky tofu, vegan mayo. Full cookbook unlock.

Access tier: Member / full cookbook. Part of Vegan Latvian Kitchen (14 recipes · 2 visitor · 2 guest · all for members + PDF).

Ingredients

  • Diced potatoes and carrots, boiled tender
  • Peas
  • Chopped dill pickles
  • Diced smoked tofu or marinated tempeh
  • Turmeric-seasoned crumbled firm tofu (“egg”)
  • Vegan mayo, salt, pepper, pickle brine

Method

  1. Boil diced potatoes and carrots until tender; cool.
  2. Fold in peas, pickles, smoked tofu, and turmeric tofu crumble.
  3. Bind with vegan mayo; season with salt, pepper, and a little pickle brine.
  4. Chill before serving.

Fully plant-based adaptation for FLOSC client UAT. Adjust salt, smoke, and timing to taste.

item.title: Vegānie pīrāgi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Latvian crescent buns with smoky filling

Classic celebration buns — yeast dough, smoky mushroom–tofu filling, no bacon required.

Member access — full site recipe 6 of 14. Members also get the cookbook PDF.

Ingredients

Dough

  • 500 ml unsweetened soy milk
  • 100 g vegan butter
  • 2 tbsp sugar
  • 10 g dry yeast
  • 100 g unsweetened soy yogurt
  • About 850–950 g wheat flour
  • 1 tbsp salt

Filling

  • 300 g smoked tofu
  • 250 g mushrooms
  • 2 onions
  • 2 tbsp oil
  • Black pepper
  • 1 tsp liquid smoke, optional

Method

  1. Warm soy milk until lukewarm; add sugar and yeast; rest ~10 minutes.
  2. Mix in melted vegan butter, yogurt and salt.
  3. Knead in flour to a soft dough; rise until doubled.
  4. Finely dice filling; fry until browned and fairly dry.
  5. Roll dough into small circles; add about a tablespoon of filling.
  6. Fold into crescent pīrāgs shapes; pinch shut.
  7. Brush with soy milk; bake at 200°C about 15–18 minutes until golden.

Fully plant-based adaptation for FLOSC client UAT. Adjust salt, smoke, and timing to taste.
item.excerpt:encoded: Classic celebration buns — yeast dough, smoky mushroom–tofu filling, no bacon required.

item.title: Sklandrausis
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Kurzeme rye tarts with potato and carrot filling

Open rye tarts — potato layer, sweet carrot top. Livonian classic, full access.

Access tier: Member / full cookbook. Part of Vegan Latvian Kitchen (14 recipes · 2 visitor · 2 guest · all for members + PDF).

Ingredients

Rye shells

  • 250 g rye flour
  • 50 g wheat flour
  • 40 ml oil or melted vegan butter
  • 150–170 ml warm water
  • ½ tsp salt

Potato layer

  • 400 g potatoes
  • 60 ml unsweetened soy milk
  • Salt

Carrot layer

  • 500 g carrots
  • 2–3 tbsp sugar
  • 100 g soy yogurt or vegan sour cream
  • ½ tsp caraway seeds
  • Pinch of cinnamon

Method

  1. Boil potatoes and carrots separately.
  2. Mash potatoes with soy milk and salt.
  3. Purée carrots with sugar, yogurt, caraway and cinnamon.
  4. Mix rye-shell ingredients into a firm dough; form tart shells with raised edges.
  5. Potato layer first, then carrot mixture.
  6. Bake at 190°C about 20–25 minutes; serve cool or slightly warm.

Fully plant-based adaptation for FLOSC client UAT. Adjust salt, smoke, and timing to taste.

item.title: Rupjmaizes kārtojums
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Layered Latvian rye-bread dessert

Dark rye crumbs, berry jam, plant cream — layered and chilled.

Access tier: Member / full cookbook. Part of Vegan Latvian Kitchen (14 recipes · 2 visitor · 2 guest · all for members + PDF).

Ingredients

  • 300 g dark Latvian rye bread
  • 3 tbsp brown sugar
  • 1 tsp cinnamon
  • 300 g lingonberry, cranberry or blackcurrant jam
  • 400 ml vegan whipping cream
  • 2 tbsp icing sugar, vanilla

Method

  1. Dry rye bread in the oven until crisp; grind into coarse crumbs.
  2. Mix crumbs with brown sugar and cinnamon.
  3. Whip vegan cream with icing sugar and vanilla.
  4. Layer rye crumbs, berry jam and cream; repeat.
  5. Refrigerate several hours or overnight.

Use genuine dark Latvian rupjmaize when you can.

Fully plant-based adaptation for FLOSC client UAT. Adjust salt, smoke, and timing to taste.

item.title: Skābeņu zupa
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Latvian sorrel soup

Spring green soup — sorrel, potatoes, smoky tofu, plant cream finish.

Access tier: Member / full cookbook. Part of Vegan Latvian Kitchen (14 recipes · 2 visitor · 2 guest · all for members + PDF).

Ingredients

  • 400–500 g sorrel
  • 5 potatoes
  • 1 onion
  • 150 g smoked tofu
  • 2 litres vegetable stock
  • 1 bay leaf, black pepper, salt
  • 1 tbsp oil
  • Vegan sour cream, fresh dill

Method

  1. Dice and fry smoked tofu until browned; remove.
  2. Fry onion briefly; add stock, bay leaf and diced potatoes.
  3. Cook until potatoes are tender.
  4. Chop sorrel; add for final 3–5 minutes.
  5. Return tofu; season; serve with vegan sour cream and dill.

Fully plant-based adaptation for FLOSC client UAT. Adjust salt, smoke, and timing to taste.
item.excerpt:encoded: Spring green soup — sorrel, potatoes, smoky tofu, plant cream finish.

item.title: Debesmanna
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Whipped semolina berry dessert

Cloud-light berry dessert — aquafaba instead of egg whites.

Access tier: Member / full cookbook. Part of Vegan Latvian Kitchen (14 recipes · 2 visitor · 2 guest · all for members + PDF).

Ingredients

  • Semolina
  • Cranberry or lingonberry juice
  • Aquafaba (chickpea brine)
  • Sugar
  • Berry sauce for serving

Method

  1. Cook semolina with berry juice until thickened; cool slightly.
  2. Whip aquafaba to stiff peaks with a little sugar.
  3. Fold together and whip until light and fluffy.
  4. Chill; serve with berry sauce.

Fully plant-based adaptation for FLOSC client UAT. Adjust salt, smoke, and timing to taste.

item.title: Kotletes
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Plant-based Latvian-style patties

Home-style kotletes — lentils, mushrooms, herbs, pan-fried crisp.

Access tier: Member / full cookbook. Part of Vegan Latvian Kitchen (14 recipes · 2 visitor · 2 guest · all for members + PDF).

Ingredients

  • 400 g cooked lentils, mushrooms, or mix + cooked potato or oats for binding
  • 1–2 onions, grated/sautéed
  • Flour or breadcrumbs
  • Salt, pepper, dill, parsley, optional smoked paprika
  • Oil for frying

Method

  1. Mash or pulse into a firm mixture that holds shape.
  2. Form patties; coat lightly in flour/breadcrumbs if desired.
  3. Pan-fry until crisp and browned.
  4. Serve with potatoes, vegan gravy, or mushroom sauce.

Fully plant-based adaptation for FLOSC client UAT. Adjust salt, smoke, and timing to taste.

item.title: Bukstiņbiezputra
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Barley and potato porridge

Comfort porridge — pearl barley, potatoes, plant cream, dill.

Access tier: Member / full cookbook. Part of Vegan Latvian Kitchen (14 recipes · 2 visitor · 2 guest · all for members + PDF).

Ingredients

  • Pearl barley
  • Potatoes, diced
  • Onion
  • Plant milk or cream + oil/vegan butter
  • Salt, pepper, dill

Method

  1. Cook barley until nearly tender.
  2. Add diced potatoes and onion; cook until soft.
  3. Stir in plant milk/cream and fat for richness.
  4. Season; finish with dill.

Fully plant-based adaptation for FLOSC client UAT. Adjust salt, smoke, and timing to taste.

item.title: Burkānlaša smalkmaizītes ar paštaisītu burkānlasi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Canapés with homemade carrot “lox”

Modern café classic — silky smoked carrot on rye or smalkmaizītes.

Access tier: Member / full cookbook. Part of Vegan Latvian Kitchen (14 recipes · 2 visitor · 2 guest · all for members + PDF).

Ingredients

Burkānlaša

  • 3–4 large carrots
  • 2 tbsp soy sauce or tamari
  • 1 tbsp maple syrup or sugar
  • 1–2 tsp liquid smoke
  • 1 tbsp oil
  • Nori flakes or dulse optional (sea note)
  • Black pepper

To serve

  • Dark rye or smalkmaizītes
  • Vegan cream cheese or cashew cream
  • Dill, capers, red onion

Method

  1. Peel carrots into long ribbons with a peeler.
  2. Toss with soy sauce, maple, liquid smoke, oil, nori, pepper.
  3. Marinate 30+ minutes (better overnight); optionally roast or pan-warm briefly until pliable.
  4. Spread cream on bread; fold carrot “lox” on top.
  5. Finish with dill, capers, onion.

Fully plant-based adaptation for FLOSC client UAT. Adjust salt, smoke, and timing to taste.
item.excerpt:encoded: Modern café classic — silky smoked carrot on rye or smalkmaizītes.

item.title: Tofu–mushroom “roast beef”
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Smoky seared tofu–mushroom roast

Ridiculously delicious plant roast — umami, smoke, sliceable centerpiece.

Access tier: Member / full cookbook. Part of Vegan Latvian Kitchen (14 recipes · 2 visitor · 2 guest · all for members + PDF).

Ingredients

  • 400 g firm or extra-firm tofu, pressed
  • 300 g mushrooms (brown or mixed), finely chopped
  • 2 tbsp soy sauce or tamari
  • 1–2 tsp liquid smoke
  • 1 tbsp tomato paste
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • 2 tbsp oil
  • 1 small onion or shallot, minced
  • 2 cloves garlic
  • 1–2 tbsp nutritional yeast optional
  • Black pepper, salt
  • Optional: beet juice or paprika for “roast” colour

Method

  1. Sauté mushrooms and onion until deeply browned and dry; add garlic.
  2. Crumble or pulse tofu; mix with mushrooms, soy, smoke, tomato paste, paprika, yeast, pepper.
  3. Pack into a loaf shape or tightly wrapped log; rest 20 minutes.
  4. Sear in oil on all sides until dark crust forms; finish in oven ~180°C 15–25 min if needed.
  5. Rest, slice thin; serve with potatoes, horseradish-style cashew cream, or pickle.

Member showpiece — full cookbook unlock.

Fully plant-based adaptation for FLOSC client UAT. Adjust salt, smoke, and timing to taste.
